messages:
ava: Quick design check — new retention accordion in the Compliance panel. putting up the Figma and a screenshot: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/retention-panel (see ‘policy-summary’ frame). Can we do a quick pass on ordering + copy + accessibility?

sam: looks clean overall. main thing I noticed: CTA placement feels odd when the accordion is collapsed. users might expect action next to the policy title, not buried in the body.

jordan: Agree. Also the region chip order is weird — it shows region after KMS which feels backwards for customers who think region = data residency. Should be Region > Retention > Encryption imo.

liz: Copy nits: the summary line currently reads `Retention: 90 days · Managed key`. That conflates two different concepts. Suggest split into two inline tags: `90 days` and `Managed key (Redwood)` or `Customer key (BYOK)` for clarity.

matt: From a security perspective, we need clearer labeling for key ownership. "Managed key" is ambiguous — some teams think it means Redwood can read keys. Maybe `Redwood-managed key` vs `Customer-managed key (BYOK)` so it's explicit.

katie: Accessibility nits: accordion header should be a button with aria-expanded, and the CTA inside should be reachable via keyboard as the next focusable control. Also ensure we don't collapse instruction text into a `display:none` that screen readers skip.

ava: Good points. Specific ask: 1) reorder chips 2) move primary CTA to header (but visible only in collapsed state as an icon) 3) update KMS copy 4) audit log copy check (see sample below).

sam: For the CTA in header — +1 for an icon button, but let's keep the full text CTA in the expanded panel so it's clear. Icon only for collapsed. Make sure tooltip explains action.

jordan: Will be tricky with our responsive layout. Header icon needs enough hit area. Also when multiple policies present, the header actions should be per-row not global.

liz: Microcopy suggestion for header tooltip: `Change retention` -> `Edit retention policy`. More direct.

ava: Audit log copy: current event is `policy.updated: retention set to 90`. That reads terse. Suggest: `Retention policy updated: changed from 30 days to 90 days by liz@example.com` — include actor and delta.

matt: +1. Also include KMS tag in the audit entry when relevant: `... and key set to Customer-managed (BYOK)`. This helps compliance reviews.

ava: Example audit line for prod logs (for devs to mock):
```
2024-02-12T14:03:22Z policy.update user=liz@example.com policy_id=pol_123 action="retention:update" before=30d after=90d kms_owner="customer" region=eu-west-1
```

katie: Small a11y tweak: when the accordion expands, add `role="status"` or an `aria-live="polite"` region summarizing the open panel so keyboard/sr users know context changed. Test with VoiceOver.

sam: One more UX nit: when the region is unset we fallback to `Global` in the chip. That’s confusing. Suggest explicit `Region: Not selected` or a prompt `Select region` with a chevron to open the region picker.

ava: Ok next steps I propose: liz to update microcopy and tooltip strings, jordan to prototype header icon + focus order, katie to run quick VoiceOver pass, matt to draft audit schema line for backend, sam to validate layout with responsive constraints. I can push a small Figma update by EOD.

liz: I’ll send the copy PR. Quick ideas: header tooltip -> `Edit retention policy`, chip labels -> `90 days`, `Redwood-managed` / `Customer-managed (BYOK)`.

jordan: I’ll try a couple of variations for collapsed header (icon-only vs small text) and post screenshots.

matt: I’ll add `kms_owner` and `actor_email` fields to the audit event example and share with infra.

katie: Will test keyboard nav + aria-live and report back.

design-bot: New comment added to Figma frame by ava: "header action small icon for collapsed state — see /comments/42" (automated).

ava: Thanks everyone — feels actionable. If anyone else spots copy that reads like we own keys, flag it here. (reacted :thumbsup:)
